title: User profiles identity page
lede: User profiles keep the same tab URLs. Identity lives in the header, Info splits Contact / Work / Assignments, Slack is editable, and Activity/Badges filters sit on the 40px baseline.

sections.heading: Side by side
sections.note: Matched Cursor IDE Chromium captures at 1372×1160 CSS pixels (PNGs 2744×2320), ADMIN Erik Role, dark appearance, authenticated local Preview at 127.0.0.1:3000. Parallel page-chrome work is visible in the global sidebar.
